_notes: All 352 keys reviewed against the current English; no null `cur` in this job. 27 patched, the rest kept.

Plan = 'tarif' per the brief and the marketing/common patch (student:v9.money.note.HANGYUL_FEE_NONE said 'reja'). OWNER DECISION: the uz-student-mobile patch standardized the opposite way ('reja'); one of the two must flip so the Student app and marketing match. 'Reja' is kept where it is not the product (viza rejangiz = your visa plan, ariza topshirish rejangiz = application plan).
Consular legalization = 'konsullik legalizatsiyasi' (dominant in the locale, 25 uses); the 'legallashtirish/legallashtiruvi' variants in these screens are aligned.
Study plan = 'oʻqish rejasi' (success:item.FIELD_DIFFERENT.why said 'oʻquv rejasi' = curriculum).

Where the CURRENT English still says 'your counselor' (success:item.DOC_REVIEW_LATE/ESSAY_REVIEW/SCHOLARSHIP_NONE, visaroute caveats, concierge housing/lease), 'maslahatchingiz' is kept to match. OWNER DECISION: the rest of the Student app now says 'the Hangyul team'; if the English is aligned later, these ~40 Uzbek strings should follow ('Hangyul jamoasi').

Announced-but-not-in-force visa rules (student:v9.announced.rule.*) now use the planned/conditional form ('…rejalashtirilgan'), as the English 'would' does; two of three read as rules already in force.
student:v9.sponsor.foot carried an extra sentence ('all decisions are made by universities and embassies') not in the English; removed.
Suffixes attached to placeholders where a string was patched anyway ({{university}}ga, {{label}}ni); untouched strings with a spaced suffix were left as is.

writing:auto.studentNote.text: Bu inson emas, qoidalarga asoslangan avtomatik tekshiruv. U tekshirish kerak boʻlgan gaplarni koʻrsatadi — matningizni hech qachon oʻzgartirmaydi va oʻrningizga yozmaydi.

visaroute:caveat.APOSTILLE_TRANSITION.text: Vyetnam 2026-yil 11-sentabrdan apostil bera boshladi, lekin elchixonaning talaba vizasi roʻyxatlarida hali ham konsullik legalizatsiyasi yozilgan. Qaysi biri qabul qilinishini Hangyul jamoasi aniqlaydi.

visaroute:step.slow_items.why.text: Apostil yoki konsullik legalizatsiyasi, sil (TB) tekshiruvi va politsiya maʼlumotnomalari haftalab vaqt olishi mumkin.

visaroute:track.handoffText.text: Navbatni elchixonaning rasmiy sahifasida olasiz. Rejangiz shu yerda qoladi, shuning uchun qaytib kelib, sana va kvitansiya raqamingizni yozib qoʻying.
